C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

def boxIff' (h : 𝓢 ⊢ φ ⭤ ψ) : 𝓢 ⊢ (□φ ⭤ □ψ) := by
  /-
    S : Type u_1
    F : Type u_2
    inst✝³ : LO.BasicModalLogicalConnective F
    inst✝² : DecidableEq F
    inst✝¹ : LO.System F S
    𝓢 : S
    inst✝ : LO.System.K 𝓢
    φ ψ : F
    h : LO.System.Prf 𝓢 (LO.LogicalConnective.iff φ ψ)
    ⊢ LO.System.Prf 𝓢 (LO.LogicalConnective.iff (LO.Box.box φ) (LO.Box.box ψ))
  -/
  apply iffIntro;
    /-
      case b₁
      S : Type u_1
      F : Type u_2
      inst✝³ : LO.BasicModalLogicalConnective F
      inst✝² : DecidableEq F
      inst✝¹ : LO.System F S
      𝓢 : S
      inst✝ : LO.System.K 𝓢
      φ ψ : F
      h : LO.System.Prf 𝓢 (LO.LogicalConnective.iff φ ψ)
      ⊢ LO.System.Prf 𝓢 (LO.Arrow.arrow (LO.Box.box φ) (LO.Box.box ψ))
    -/
  . exact axiomK' $ nec $ and₁' h;
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/
    /-
      case b₂
      S : Type u_1
      F : Type u_2
      inst✝³ : LO.BasicModalLogicalConnective F
      inst✝² : DecidableEq F
      inst✝¹ : LO.System F S
      𝓢 : S
      inst✝ : LO.System.K 𝓢
      φ ψ : F
      h : LO.System.Prf 𝓢 (LO.LogicalConnective.iff φ ψ)
      ⊢ LO.System.Prf 𝓢 (LO.Arrow.arrow (LO.Box.box ψ) (LO.Box.box φ))
    -/
  . exact axiomK' $ nec $ and₂' h;
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/

import Foundation.Modal.System.Basic

namespace LO.System

open FiniteContext

variable {S F : Type*} [BasicModalLogicalConnective F] [DecidableEq F] [System F S]
variable {𝓢 : S} [System.K 𝓢]

def multibox_axiomK : 𝓢 ⊢ □^[n](φ ➝ ψ) ➝ □^[n]φ ➝ □^[n]ψ := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp; apply impId;
  | succ n ih => simpa using impTrans'' (axiomK' $ nec ih) (by apply axiomK);
